p.default: Don't see yours? Ask a scientist and a member of our team will follow up.

button.default: What kinds of studies does Alpha Preclinical run?−

ans.default: We specialize in early preclinical in vivo research: PK/PD and lead optimization, feasibility and proof-of-concept, efficacy, and iterative testing, supported by imaging, surgery and in vitro analysis.

default.button: Can you run a custom or literature-based model?+
default.ans: Yes. Our scientists regularly adapt existing models or set up a model from a published paper, and we confirm the design with you before any animals are enrolled.

default.button: Which in vitro readouts can you add to an in vivo study?+
default.ans: Flow cytometry (including T and B cell immunophenotyping and stimulation assays), ELISA and cytokine panels, CBC differentials, serum chemistry, primary cell isolation, cell culture and immunohistochemistry.

default.button: Where is Alpha Preclinical located?+
default.ans: Our vivarium and laboratories are at 722 Plantation Street in Worcester, Massachusetts, within easy reach of the Boston and Cambridge biotech community.

default.button: How do I get a study quote?+
default.ans: Send us your compound, target and timeline through the quote form. A senior scientist will follow up to scope the study and send a design and quote.
